caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair set against a plain, beige background. The chair features a dark brown, polished wood frame with a shield-shaped backrest that incorporates an ornate design of carved lines, including a central vertical element flanked by symmetrical curved lines and tassel-like decorations hanging from the top. The seat appears upholstered in a dark, possibly brown or black material and is outlined with a row of metallic studs or tacks along its edge. The chair’s legs are straight, also made of dark wood, with the front two legs having a slight taper and decorative feet, while the back legs are simple and straight. The artist’s name “LOUIS. ANNING” is visible in small text in the bottom left corner. There are no additional objects or elements in the image.
title: Side Chair
